statement: The three Q8 sign elliptic quotients admit isogenies giving punctured maps with exactly the four cusps over the origin; the stable D4 genus-two complement has a degree-two punctured map to the CM(-2) elliptic factor; the stable D3 one-Weierstrass-cusp curve has only one admissible elliptic factor.
depends_on: A.4; elementary two-isogeny formula, Riemann–Hurwitz and genus-two canonical system
answers: Task A.4; Task A.5, geometric maps for normalizer detection
notes: Q8 degrees4,4,8, all j1728; stable D4 degree2 target j8000 with explicit endomorphism squaring to[-2]. Every admissible stable D3 map has degree3 and ramification2P; maps are unique up to pointed target isomorphism. Does not itself assert the remaining pro-l normalizer theorem.
